product_benefits_items.product_benefits_item_title: Access to the US E-2 visa

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: The E-2 is a long-term US investor and business visa that can be extended without limit while the business continues to operate and you continue to qualify; it is a non-immigrant visa, not a green card.
You become eligible to file an E-2 application after at least 3 continuous years of domicile in Grenada — a stricter test than simply holding the passport
Available to the investor and the family

product_benefits_items.product_benefits_item_title: Visa-free travel to more than 140 countries and territories

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: Visa-free access to the Schengen Area: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
Visa-free access to many European countries, China and others
Visa-free for UK travel; an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) is required before you travel
Available to the whole family — for tourism, visiting relatives, business or transit
Stays of up to 6 months per visit

acf.product_advantages_title: What sets the Grenada program apart

product_advantages_item_bullets.product_advantages_item_bullet_text: Grandparents, parents and children from both sides of the family can obtain citizenship in a single application.

product_advantages_items.product_advantages_item_title: The entire process is handled remotely

product_advantages_item_bullets.product_advantages_item_bullet_text: No site visit to Grenada is required
No travel to Grenada at any stage of the process
You do not need to live in Grenada to keep your citizenship.

product_advantages_items.product_advantages_item_footnote: Regional rules for the Eastern Caribbean (ECCIRA), expected to take effect in mid-2026, would require a total of 30 days of presence during the first 5 years; applications filed before those rules take effect remain under the current requirements.

product_advantages_item_bullets.product_advantages_item_bullet_text: Grenada does not tax the worldwide income of its citizens. A second citizenship does not by itself change where you are tax resident, so your own position should be reviewed with an independent tax advisor.
Grenada is a member of the Commonwealth
Easier trade, study and travel within the Commonwealth

product_advantages_items.product_advantages_item_title: Citizenship that passes to the next generation

Supports long-term planning for the whole family

Diversifying your assets across several jurisdictions — long-term financial protection for the whole family

acf.product_process_title: The Grenada citizenship process, step by step

product_process_steps.product_process_step_desc: Sign the deposit agreement and complete the initial due diligence on your file.

product_process_steps.product_process_step_title: Sign the contracts and prepare your file
product_process_steps.product_process_step_desc: Sign the service agreement and begin preparing the application documents.

product_process_step_bullets.product_process_step_bullet_text: File the source-of-funds report and the formal application with the Government of Grenada.
A mandatory interview for the main applicant and every dependent aged 16 and over — online or in person.

product_process_steps.product_process_step_title: Approval and completion of the investment
product_process_steps.product_process_step_desc: Receive approval in principle, then complete the donation or the remaining 90% of the investment.
Receive final approval, complete the oath of allegiance online, and receive your certificate of citizenship and Grenadian passport.

acf.product_faq_title: Grenada citizenship by investment: frequently asked questions

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Does the total cost depend on how many family members are included?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Yes — the total cost depends on how many family members are included

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Donation: US$235,000 for a family of up to 4 people
Real estate: from US$270,000 in a government-approved project
These vary with the number, age and relationship of the dependents
The total cost is quoted in detail for each individual application

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What does the real estate route actually cost?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: An equity investment from US$270,000 in a government-approved project, plus a US$50,000 government contribution.
After the 5-year holding period you may transfer the investment and recover your capital; your citizenship is not conditional on continued ownership.

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_note: Figures quoted as "from US$270,000" refer to the equity investment only; the US$50,000 government contribution is payable on top.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What happens to my citizenship if the project fails?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Once granted, your citizenship does not depend on the outcome of the project
How long it takes to obtain citizenship

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Assessment takes 6–8 months

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Investor protection if a project fails

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The failure of a project is not a ground for withdrawing citizenship that has already been granted
Whether you can recover your capital if a project is not completed depends on the terms of your purchase agreement with the developer, so review those terms carefully before you sign
Recovering your capital once the holding requirement has been met does not affect your citizenship

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What are the risks of obtaining Grenadian citizenship?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The InterContinental Grenada Resort is approved by the Government of Grenada under the CBI program
Separately, the government carries out its own due diligence into every investor
Capital is transferred only after your application receives approval in principle
The most common reason for refusal is an unsuccessful due diligence check — typically a criminal record, or a source of funds that cannot be evidenced
IMM Group reviews your file thoroughly before any contract is signed

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What benefits do Grenadian citizens receive?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Free tuition from primary through the end of secondary school
St. George's University (SGU) — up to 90% off tuition, depending on the program
Strong academic results at SGU can open internship and training opportunities in the US
A well-developed healthcare system
Free basic public healthcare services, including consultations and diagnostics

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What does Grenada's economy rely on?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Grenada's economy — tourism as the mainstay

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Steady GDP growth
Tourism is the mainstay of the economy, accounting for more than half of GDP — a factor investors weigh when assessing rental demand in resort real estate
Visitor numbers up 20.45% compared with 2017
The US is adding direct flights to Grenada
The government is actively promoting tourism real estate projects

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_note: Key sectors: tourism, agriculture and education.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What is the education system like in Grenada?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Most schools teach in English
227 schools: 113 preschools, 78 primary and secondary schools, and several universities
Around 8,000 international students, 70% of them from the US
One of the larger sources of physicians for the US healthcare system
Grenadian citizens receive up to 90% off tuition on selected programs

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Under 18: free from primary through the end of secondary school
University: up to 90% off tuition on selected programs

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: When does the US–Grenada E-2 treaty expire?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The E-2 treaty has no expiry date

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Signed in 1989
More than 30 years in force, without amendment
A stable treaty with no expiry date

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Do I have to travel to Grenada to obtain citizenship?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: You do not need to travel to Grenada

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: There is no requirement to visit Grenada before or after you obtain citizenship
You may travel to Grenada, or
Take the oath at a Grenadian consulate

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Do I need to have lived in Grenada to apply for an E-2 visa?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The E-2 visa requires 3 years of domicile in Grenada

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Grenadian citizens who acquired citizenship through investment must be domiciled in Grenada for 3 continuous years before filing an E-2 application — a US requirement that applies to citizenship obtained through an investment program. Domicile means actual residence with the intention of remaining, which is a stricter test than holding the passport.
It is the only route to the E-2 visa in the Caribbean: Grenada is the only Caribbean country with an E-2 treaty with the US, in force since 1989.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Up to what age can children be included?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: One of the broadest dependent policies in the Caribbean — children under 30, and siblings and grandparents from both sides of the family

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Grenada managed the outbreak effectively
Operations returned to normal
Applications continued to be assessed on schedule
